baseline_models.focus_anchor: The posture in muttaki'ina rests directly on rafraf khudr and abqari hisan.
baseline_models.mechanism: A reclining body transfers its weight into two coordinated material layers: a green draped or overhanging surface and finely patterned furnishings. Beauty is therefore tactile and load-bearing, not merely seen.

activation_trace.role: Leaning on a support supplies the bodily dependency that makes the named surfaces load-bearing.
A hanging flap or overhanging edge makes rafraf a draped support or sheltering textile edge.
Green shading toward darkness supplies saturated color and visual depth to the draped layer.
Rich patterned furnishings identify the second layer as crafted textile rather than generic scenery.
Beauty opposed to ugliness confirms the pleasing finish of the supporting ensemble.

changed_reading.before: The ayah inventories attractive green furnishings beneath reclining occupants.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages embodied repose in layered material support: weight, drape, saturated color, pattern, and finish work together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Rafraf khudr can carry foliage, flutter, and fresh growth while the body remains anchored by muttaki'ina.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rafraf oscillates between a support and spreading foliage whose edges move like wings; khudr supplies moist fresh growth, and abqari adds shimmer. The resting place can thus be a responsive verdant canopy rather than inert upholstery.

activation_trace.role: Actual reliance keeps the living-canopy reading attached to a usable resting structure.
Fluttering wings contribute repeated edge-motion to the reclining environment.
Spreading verdant foliage supplies the canopy's organic material and dangling reach.
Fresh green growth makes the color a sign of living moisture rather than pigment alone.
Mirage-like shimmer contributes changing light across the moving foliage without yet deciding whether it is textile or plant.

changed_reading.before: Rafraf is a static green furnishing.
changed_reading.after: Rafraf can be a moving, light-responsive spread of living greenery that also functions as repose architecture.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Abqari hisan follows a posture of reliance, so excellence can describe what the setting does for its occupants.
baseline_models.mechanism: Exceptional mastery, enacted goodness, prosperous freshness, and reliable support form a functional hospitality system. The scene's excellence lies in enabling ease, not only in costly appearance.

activation_trace.role: Reliance turns the scene into a test of whether its craft actually supports the body.
Fresh ease and prosperity supply the lived condition produced by the setting.
Exceptional excellence and mastery make skilled fabrication a live sense of abqari.
Beneficent or skillful good action lets hisan qualify performance and benefit as well as appearance.

changed_reading.before: The furnishings signal luxury through decoration.
changed_reading.after: The furnishings embody mastered hospitality: they are excellent because they produce supported ease and beneficent use.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier placing of the balance activates an architectural reading of the focus posture: support, mastery, and goodness converge on a deliberately proportioned distribution of bodily load.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in a settled or lower place supplies the act of establishing a bearing surface.
Balancing and aligning two things supplies calibrated relation between body and support.
Leaning makes calibrated support physically consequential in the focus ayah.
Exceptional mastery assigns the proportional support to skilled making.
Skillful good action makes successful load-bearing part of the setting's goodness.

structural_cues: The body-over-surface construction with ala echoes the vertical ordering of raised sky and placed balance in 55:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies placement, alignment, reliance, and mastery; I infer an engineering arrow from balance to load-bearing comfort; alternatively, the balance may remain ethical or cosmic with no material carryover.

changed_reading.after: Mastery also means proportioned support: the beautiful setting succeeds by holding a reclined body in equilibrium.

context_deltas.mechanism: The meeting seas and their non-transgressing interval activate the focus coordination as an interface between organic rafraf and crafted abqari. Distinct materials can meet beneath one posture without being collapsed into synonyms.

activation_trace.role: Two facing things coming together supplies contact between unlike domains.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies an interface rather than simple separation.
Crossing a limit through aggression supplies the blocked collapse of one side into the other.
Spreading foliage supplies the organic side of the focus interface.
Rich patterned furnishings supply the crafted side of the focus interface.

structural_cues: The conjunction in rafrafin khudrin wa-abqariyyin hisan places two materials under one reclining relation while preserving two noun phrases.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies meeting, an intervening connection, boundedness, foliage, and textile; I infer boundary-preserving adjacency as a material analogy; alternatively, rafraf and abqari may simply be coordinate furnishing names.

changed_reading.before: Rafraf and abqari are two near-synonyms for luxurious bedding.
changed_reading.after: They can remain different but cooperating domains, joining living growth to crafted pattern at the body's resting interface.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier gleam, coating, and coral-like materiality activate the flutter and mirage branches in the focus as optical behavior. Pattern becomes a moving response to light rather than a flat motif.

activation_trace.role: Gleaming or sparkling supplies point-like light across precious material.
Oil and coating supply a smooth reflective surface that changes with viewing angle.
Coral between pearl and bead supplies colored, particulate patterning.
Fluttering supplies motion that continually reorients the reflective surface.
Mirage shimmer supplies the focus surface's unstable gleam while remaining anchored in abqari.

structural_cues: The sequence repeatedly renders materials through light effects: pearl and coral in 55:22, rose and oil in 55:37, then ruby and coral in 55:58.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gleam, coating, colored material, flutter, and mirage; I infer changing light across a moving patterned surface; alternatively, the earlier comparisons are independent ornaments with no shared optics.

changed_reading.before: Abqari presents a fixed woven pattern.
changed_reading.after: The focus surface can be kinetic and iridescent, its pattern appearing through motion, reflection, and changing light.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact earlier reclining construction assigns the focus nouns the functional slot of bedding, but its explicit bed and lining also differentiates layers. Rafraf can name an outer drape or overhang while abqari names the richly patterned furnishing.

activation_trace.role: The repeated act of reclining supplies a direct postural parallel to the focus ayah.
Furnishings and bedding establish the material class occupying the earlier parallel construction.
A garment or textile lining exposes an interior layer and makes constructional depth explicit.
A hanging or overhanging edge supplies the outer, draped layer in the revised focus scene.
Fine patterned carpets supply the richly worked furnishing layer.

structural_cues: 55:54 and 55:76 repeat muttaki'ina ala and then replace the objects of repose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel syntax, bedding, lining, draped edges, and carpets; I infer a functional analogy with differentiated textile layers; alternatively, rafraf's foliage branch may make the second scene deliberately less textile-bound.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives an undifferentiated pair of luxurious surfaces.
changed_reading.after: Against 55:54, it reveals a layered construction: bedding and lining are recast as overhanging green edges and patterned outer furnishings.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reciprocity formula at 55:60 reactivates hisan as enacted excellence. Joined to abqari mastery and bodily reliance, the furnishings become the material performance of beneficence or fitting recompense.

activation_trace.role: Answering an act with its recompense supplies the reciprocal mechanism surrounding the garden scenes.
Beneficent or skillful good action supplies an active sense of ihsan on both sides of the formula.
Reliance shows the resulting goodness being received as bodily support.
Exceptional mastery supplies the skilled quality through which beneficence is materialized.
Skillful good action lets hisan retain action-value inside its adjectival role.

structural_cues: The ihsan reciprocity statement stands between the two garden sequences, and the same root returns in 55:70 and the focus ending hisan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, repeated active ihsan, mastery, and received support; I infer that action-value persists in the focus adjective; alternatively, hisan may have narrowed entirely to visible beauty.

changed_reading.before: Hisan only praises how the furnishings look.
changed_reading.after: Hisan can praise what they enact: skillfully made support realizes beneficence and reciprocal reward as usable comfort.

context_deltas.mechanism: Darkening vegetation, abundant spurting water, and palms turn focus greenness into an ecological state. The rafraf can be a dense palm-like canopy whose saturated shade is continuously sustained by water.

activation_trace.role: Dark blackness sharpens green toward dense shade rather than bright pigment.
Water that wells up abundantly supplies an active moisture source for the garden material.
The palm tree supplies the concrete plant whose fronds can spread into the focus canopy.
Spreading verdant foliage converts rafraf from furniture alone into a canopy of moving growth.
Green shading into dark joins the focus color directly to the preceding dense black-green state.
Green palm fronds provide the material bridge from the named palms to rafraf khudr.

structural_cues: 55:64, 55:66, 55:68, and 55:76 alternate compressed garden states: dark density, water pressure, fruiting plants, then repose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies darkening, abundant water, palms, and matching focus branches; I infer the directional arrow water sustains dense canopy growth; alternatively, these are adjacent amenities without an ecological causal relation.

changed_reading.before: Khudr is a color adjective on a furnishing.
changed_reading.after: Khudr indexes water-sustained, densely shaded plant life, making the resting surface part of a functioning garden ecology.

context_deltas.mechanism: Confinement within tents activates rafraf's hanging flap as a controlled boundary. Reclining occurs inside protected, selectively accessible space rather than on furniture displayed in an open field.

activation_trace.role: Confinement or restriction to something supplies selective enclosure.
Tent and encampment supply the architectural shell around the nearby repose scene.
A tent flap or overhanging edge becomes the focus boundary that both shelters and screens.
Reclining anchors enclosure to an inhabited rest posture rather than an abstract boundary.

structural_cues: The tent enclosure at 55:72 is followed by the repeated untouching formula at 55:74 and then the focus repose; ط م ث is branchless in the packet and is used here only as sequence structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confinement, tents, an overhanging flap, and the preserved-access sequence; I infer a shelter-and-privacy function for rafraf; alternatively, the enclosure may characterize occupants only and not the furnishings.

changed_reading.before: The verse displays luxurious furnishings for inspection.
changed_reading.after: It can stage protected repose, with the green overhang functioning as an inhabited boundary that regulates exposure and access.

context_deltas.mechanism: Abqari can shimmer like a mirage or carry a pure-lie idiom, yet muttaki'ina places bodily weight upon it. The immediate denial refrain turns fantastic appearance into a reality test: the marvel is not merely visual because it bears the recliner.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood opposed to truth supplies the explicit denial axis immediately after the focus scene.
Leaning or relying supplies tactile, weight-bearing verification within the focus ayah.
Mirage shimmer supplies the possibility that marvelous appearance could be optically unstable.
The pure-lie idiom intensifies the semantic risk that abqari excellence could be dismissed as fabrication.

structural_cues: 55:77 places the repeated denial question directly after the focus and therefore after the body's act of reliance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily reliance, mirage and pure-lie branches, and an adjacent denial refrain; I infer that weight-bearing reverses seeming into verification; alternatively, the abqari idioms and refrain are unrelated lexical possibilities.

changed_reading.before: The scene is fantastic enough to resemble an unreal decorative vision.
changed_reading.after: Its very posture answers that risk: marvelous shimmer is tested by touch and weight, so repose functions as embodied verification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier contrast of perishing and remaining, joined to the final image of stable growing good, relocates the focus object's reliability. The supports are dependable manifestations of continuing beneficence, not self-sufficient possessions.

activation_trace.role: Continuance and remaining supply the durable pole against which material repose is measured.
Stable, growing good supplies a generative source for the focus scene's sustained ease.
Reliance makes durability matter as lived support rather than abstract permanence.
Fresh prosperity gives the support a growing, renewing quality.
Beneficent action presents the renewed support as goodness being done for occupants.

structural_cues: The focus is framed by the surah's earlier perish/remain contrast in 55:26-27 and by tabaraka in the closing 55:78.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remaining, stable growing good, reliance, prosperity, and beneficence; I infer source-grounded renewal as the reason the repose is trustworthy; alternatively, the permanence frame may govern the whole surah without specifying these furnishings.

changed_reading.before: The scene offers durable-looking luxury as an end in itself.
changed_reading.after: The repose is reliable because it is continually grounded in stable, growing beneficence; its material beauty remains a received effect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cold proverb and mirage branch are remote senses, so a literal climate claim would overstate them. They remain anchored in the exact abqari form and cohere with dark green and flutter; downstream prose should call this a sensory resonance, not a lexical replacement for furnishings.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Khudr, rafraf, and abqari combine darkness, motion, shimmer, and a cold proverb inside the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Fluttering wings supply a light air-moving sensation around the recliners.
Green extending into darkness supplies deep shade rather than brightness alone.
Mirage shimmer supplies wavering light across the shaded setting.
The Abqar-cold proverb contributes a distant but traceable coolness cue.
Bodily reliance keeps the sensory cluster attached to an inhabited resting place.

changed_reading.before: Color and pattern are purely visual decoration.
changed_reading.after: The same words can faintly evoke a shaded, fluttering, cool-shimmering microclimate experienced by the reclining body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading crosses from container senses into ecology and is therefore surprising. It remains anchored through muttaki'ina's tied/full-vessel branches, khudr's water-green vessel, rafraf's foliage, and the nearby gushing water; downstream prose should present it as a water-retention analogy, not as the noun's primary referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reclining root can imply tied or full containment, while khudr can mark a vessel greened by retained water and rafraf can be foliage.

activation_trace.role: A spring as a source of running water supplies inflow to the proposed habitat.
Abundantly welling water supplies pressure and replenishment.
Fastening a tie around a container supplies controlled retention.
Fullness or retained blockage supplies stored volume within the support analogy.
A vessel greened by remaining or repeated water use supplies visible water-memory.
Spreading foliage converts retained water into an inhabitable verdant surface.

changed_reading.before: The recliners rest on dry decorative upholstery beside separate water features.
changed_reading.after: The support can be imagined as a porous water-retaining habitat whose stored and renewed moisture becomes visible as green foliage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Abqari's woman branch is form-distant and must not replace the clear furnishing branch. It remains worth carrying because abqari hisan shares beauty language with the immediately preceding beautiful beings; downstream prose should describe category resonance between occupants and environment, never identify the carpets as women.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Abqari hisan can activate both a rich furnishing and, distantly, a beautiful woman, while hisan itself spans personal and object beauty.

activation_trace.role: Beauty applicable to persons and things supplies the shared predicate just before the focus scene.
Marked eye beauty supplies the animate pole of the nearby description.
Rich patterned furnishings preserve the primary material pole of abqari.
The plump beautiful woman branch supplies a distant animate echo inside the same focus word.
Beauty across person and object allows the two domains to resonate without collapsing.

changed_reading.before: The focus sharply separates beautiful occupants from beautiful objects.
changed_reading.after: Its wording lets animate and material beauty echo across the boundary, making the environment feel fitted to its occupants while retaining the furnishing referent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The strenuous-traversal sense of the reclining root is remote from the participle's ordinary support sense, and the sail-like connection is analogical. It remains anchored by the exact root, rafraf's hanging flap, hisan's utmost-limit branch, and the earlier raised vessels at sea; downstream prose should qualify it as a temporal undertone of arrival, not a hidden voyage narrative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Muttaki'ina can remotely preserve strenuous distance, rafraf can be an overhanging flap, and hisan can mark an utmost limit.

activation_trace.role: Flowing movement supplies sustained passage across a medium.
Rising or elevation supplies the raised profile of the moving constructions.
Filling a stretch by strenuous travel supplies a latent movement-history behind present reclining.
A hanging flap or overhang supplies a sail-like residual form over the resting place.
Utmost effort or limit supplies the endpoint at which exertion resolves into rest.

changed_reading.before: The reclining posture is timeless and contains no prior motion.
changed_reading.after: It can retain a faint arrival structure: distance and elevation resolve at their limit into sheltered repose.

strongest_changes: The exact 55:54 reclining parallel turns the focus into differentiated bedding, lining, overhang, and patterned furnishing rather than an undivided luxury list.
The 55:60 ihsan-recompense mechanism changes hisan from appearance alone into enacted, skillful beneficence received as support.
The 55:64-68 dark-water-palm sequence strengthens the coexisting reading of rafraf khudr as a water-sustained living canopy.
The immediate 55:77 denial refrain leaves an exploratory anti-mirage reading in which bodily weight verifies a fantastic shimmering surface.
summary.what_was_special: The five focus roots sustain several mechanisms at once: textile layering, living canopy, engineered equilibrium, enacted hospitality, protected enclosure, and embodied reality-testing. Context sharpens these without forcing rafraf and abqari into one referent.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether rafraf is primarily textile, overhang, foliage, or a deliberately oscillating material image remains unresolved.
The hydraulic, optical, cold, traversal, and animate resonances are traceable but depend on form-distant branches and must remain exploratory.
The balance-to-load-bearing and water-to-growth arrows are reader-supplied causal analogies, not directions stated by the packet.
Hisan may retain active ihsan value or may function only as an adjective of visible beauty; both readings remain live.
